record.provider: KUB.ua File Cloud (Ukraine) — Nextcloud-backed flat per-TB with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: FILE CLOUD 1: 869.57 ₴/mo for 1 TB (50 connections); FILE CLOUD 5: 1,840.36 ₴/mo for 5 TB (100 connections); FILE CLOUD 10: 3,163.12 ₴/mo for 10 TB (200 connections). Unlimited users, unlimited traffic, 7-day trial, Nextcloud platform.

per_object_cap.notes: unverified: the pricing page lists disk space, users, traffic and simultaneous connections but states no per-object cap

retention.notes: unverified: the pricing page states backup is included but states no retention period or deletion schedule

egress.terms: «Трафік не обмежений» (traffic unlimited), stated in the plan table. No meter or overage rate on the page.

record.tooling: Nextcloud. So WebDAV, and with the Nextcloud desktop client or rclone `webdav`. Nextcloud's own S3-primary-object-store is configurable only server-side, so from the client's side this is WebDAV.
record.chaining: Two sizes on the public page (1 TB, 5 TB); 20 TB needs a sales conversation. 5 TB is the only competitive point.

limits.value: 50 concurrent connections at 1 TB; 100 at 5 TB; 200 at 10 TB

record.limits_note: 50 concurrent connections at 1 TB. The 1 TB tier is poor value ($19.28/TB); the product only becomes interesting at 5 TB ($8.16/TB).
record.reliability_note: Nextcloud-on-managed-infrastructure; the vendor's own platform claim, no independent benchmark. Business-oriented (rights management, backup) rather than storage-farm. The per-TB discount from 1 TB to 5 TB is 2.36×, which is unusually steep and suggests the 1 TB price is a headline rather than a rate.
